formattedAddress: No. 70號, Meilun St, Fujia Village, Shilin District, Taipei City, Taiwan 11160

text.text: A cozy family-run restaurant! Prices are around 100 yuan, and the portions are so generous you'll be stuffed! They even have free milk tea! (☆_☆) The noodles are a must-try—chewy, not sticky, and perfectly seasoned. The traditional beef rice noodles are also amazing, and the lemon juice is self-service!

originalText.text:
溫馨的家庭餐廳！百元價位、量大到絕對吃到撐，還有免費奶茶可以喝(☆_☆)
麵疙瘩必吃，Q彈不黏牙又炒的很入味，傳統牛肉河粉也超讚，檸檬汁自助加爆

text.text:
I found this restaurant on Google Maps and decided to check it out since I had some free time.

I went in around 12:30 PM on a weekday. There was only one empty table; all the others were full.

I think there were four tables for two, three tables for four, and one table for one person. The two-person tables were very close together, making the space quite cramped.

I ordered Vietnamese fried rice (100 NTD).

I waited about ten minutes for my food, which I think is normal, considering they were serving other tables' food.

As for the taste, the Vietnamese fried rice wasn't to my liking; it wasn't bad, just not to my taste. The milk tea was just average, and it was unlimited refills.

The portion size was quite large; it felt like I had eaten a mini hot pot and two bowls of rice.

And I finished eating around 1 PM that day, so I felt full by 3 PM. I was still burping from hunger.

The environment was fairly clean, but the restaurant was quite busy. They only had time to clean the tables when customers arrived, but it seemed like they didn't wipe them. You'll probably have to wipe the tables yourself when you dine here.

Also, I found eggshells in my fried rice.

(Last photo) I'm not sure if this is an isolated incident, but I suggest customers be aware of this.

In summary: If you're looking for hearty Vietnamese food, I'd recommend trying this place.

I might come back to try other dishes later when I have time. Personally, I didn't really like the Vietnamese fried rice.

Another thing to mention, this restaurant seemed quite busy. When I sat down at the last table, three groups of customers arrived and started waiting within five minutes. So, be prepared to wait in line if you want to dine here.

originalText.text:
在Google地圖上搜到的店家，
閒著沒事就跑來吃看看，

當天是在平日中午十二點半左右進店，
裡面只剩一桌空桌，
其他全部坐滿，

印象中店內有四張雙人桌，
三張四人桌，
一張單人桌，
雙人桌都靠很近，
店內空間屬於是比較狹小的類型，

點了越式炒飯，（100元）

餐點大約等了十分鐘左右，
我覺得算是正常，
畢竟店家前面一直有在上別桌先來的餐點，

味道上的話，
越式炒飯屬於我吃不太習慣的味道，
不難吃，
就是吃不習慣，
奶茶就中規中矩，
可以無限續，

份量上的話，
算是蠻多的，
吃完有種像是吃了小火鍋加上兩碗白飯的份量，
而且我當天是在下午一點左右用餐完，
我到下午三點還在打飽嗝，

環境上的話，
還算乾淨，
店家比較忙，
基本都是有客人來，
才有時間清桌子，
但似乎都沒有擦桌子，
來這用餐，
大概是需要自己動手擦桌子，

另外一提，
炒飯裡有吃到蛋殼，
（最後一張照片）
不太清楚是不是個案，
但建議來這用餐的客人要注意，

總結：
如果想吃粗飽的越式料理，
我蠻推薦來吃這家店吃看看的，

之後有空，
我可能會再來吃看看別的餐點，
至於越式炒飯我自己是吃不慣就是了，

再另外一提，
來這家店用餐的客人，
似乎還蠻多的，
因為我當天用餐的時候，
我剛坐下最後一桌，
後面不到五分鐘就來了三批客人在等，
所以要來這用餐，
可能要有排隊的心理準備。

text.text: The salmon fried rice was fragrant and delicious, and the rice noodle soup was refreshing yet rich. Milk tea was complimentary and very tasty.

originalText.text: 鮭魚炒飯很香很好吃，湯河粉清爽不失濃郁，內用奶茶免費喝，奶茶很好喝

text.text: Affordable food, great rice noodles, fresh ingredients, delicious sauce, and free iced milk tea that tastes good. The owner is very nice.

originalText.text:
平價美食，河粉口感好，東西新鮮，醬料美味，有免費冰奶茶味道不錯
老闆人很好

text.text:
It was already 2 PM, and the shop was still packed with people 🍜. The owner was so busy that regular customers automatically helped clear the tables.

At that moment, I truly felt—this wasn't just a delicious snack shop,

but a very warm and welcoming place ❤️. The Vietnamese sandwiches were surprisingly generous. One bite and all I could say was: This is such great value for money!

The owner even helped cut them a couple of times; if you can't finish them, you can take them home.

originalText.text:
都兩點了，店內還是滿滿滿的人潮🍜
老闆忙不過來，熟客自動幫忙收桌子
那一刻真的覺得——
這不只是一家好吃的小吃店
而是一家很溫暖的店❤️
越式三明治出乎意料地豐富
一口咬下去只想說：
也太物超所值了吧！

老闆幫忙切兩刀，吃不完可以帶回去享用
